raw_response:
Let me think this through like I always do, starting from what I did last year.

I have 15.3 mu. I split it like this: about 10 mu for wheat-maize rotation — that is my main food grain, and the ground gives two harvests in one year. The other 5.3 mu I keep in cotton because my wife and daughter-in-law still pick it, and the price has been decent. I have done it this way for many years.

**Wheat (about 10 mu, winter season):**
I plant in early October, after the maize comes off. I use an improved variety — Jimai or whatever the seed shop has. My neighbors all use the same kind, good yield, stands up to wind. Before planting I plough once deep, about once every two years, otherwise just rotary. I put down compound fertilizer 50 jin per mu (25 kg) as base, that's one bag for every two mu roughly — gives me around 13-14 kg nitrogen, 7 kg phosphorus, 5 kg potassium. Then in spring when wheat greens up (March), I top-dress with urea, half a bag per mu (about 12-13 kg urea = 6 kg N more). My well water is there so I water 3 times — before winter, at jointing, and at filling. Spray 2 times — once for aphids and red spider, once for scab if weather is wet. I expect 450 kg per mu, sometimes 500 if the sky cooperates.

**Maize (about 10 mu, summer):**
Plant right after wheat harvest in June, no tillage, direct seed with the machine — saves time and the ground stays moist. Hybrid seed, Zhengdan or Xianyu type, everyone uses these. Base fertilizer 40 jin compound per mu at planting, then top-dress urea at big trumpet stage about 30 jin per mu. That gives me around 17 kg N total, 6 kg P, 4 kg K. Water once or twice if no rain. Spray 1 time for corn borer. Expect 550 kg per mu.

**Cotton (5.3 mu):**
Cotton eats more work and more medicine. Plant end of April. I use improved Bt seed — without Bt the bollworm kills you. Plough before planting, make ridges. Base fertilizer one bag DAP plus half bag potassium per mu, then urea in two times during flowering. Total about 18 kg N, 8 kg P, 8 kg K — cotton needs potassium or the bolls don't fill. Irrigate 3 times from the well. Spray many times, at least 5 — aphids early, spider mites, bollworm, and late bugs. Expect 250 kg seed cotton per mu, my land is not the best.

I do not want to change much. What worked last year I keep this year.
